name: Pixel Shift
author: Arseniy Zarechnev
description: OLED burn-in protection for the bar: walks its edge padding and center a few pixels back and forth, too slowly to notice

barWidget.description: Invisible. Slowly shifts the bar's widgets by a few pixels so static pixels on an OLED panel wear evenly.

schema.label: Shift interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar takes its next step. OLED monitors and TVs shift their picture every 2 to 3 minutes.

schema.label: Edge travel (pixels)
schema.description: How far the left and right sections move in from, and out to, their resting position. 2 gives a 5 pixel path. 0 leaves the edges alone.

schema.label: Edge step (pixels)
schema.description: Size of one edge move. Smaller steps are harder to notice and take more steps to cover the same path.

schema.label: Center travel (pixels)
schema.description: How far the centered module moves off center, one pixel at a time. 1 gives a 3 pixel path. 0 leaves the center alone.

schema.label: Shift on workspace switch
schema.description: Take the next step when the workspace changes, where the bar redraws anyway and the move is hidden. Never more often than a quarter of the interval.
